name: Noun Project
summary: Library of nearly 10 million human-made SVG and PNG icons plus stock photos, free to download with artist attribution.
description: A searchable icon library with nearly 10 million vector icons and a growing stock photo collection across thousands of artist-made styles; every icon downloads as PNG or editable SVG. Plugins for Figma, Adobe, PowerPoint, Google and a Mac app place icons directly in your tools, and a REST API serves the full collection. Free with artist attribution, with Pro and Team plans for unlimited downloads and set downloads.

free to download with attribution to the artist
style-matched icon sets and AI-enhanced search across thousands of styles
plugins for Figma, Adobe, PowerPoint, Google and a Mac app
